fields.System.Title: FDN-703 — Configuration values
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor, I want operational settings stored in the database, so that changing
over-receipt tolerance does not require a deployment.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a configuration key, then its value can be read by any module through the
  • platform service.
  • - Given a configuration change, then it is audited with who changed it and the previous
  • value.
  • - Given a change, then it takes effect without a restart.
  • - Given a value outside its allowed range, then the change is rejected.
  • - Given a missing key, then a documented default is used rather than failing.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform |
| Tables | config, audit_log |
| Risks | Behaviour changing with no record of who changed it |
| Tests | unit · integration |
